hits.snippet: # Cellebrite announces CEO succession [Loren Blinde](https://intelligencecommunitynews.com/author/loren-blinde/)November 6, 2024 On November 6, [Cellebrite](http://cellebrite.com) announced a planned leadership transition following Yossi Carmil’s decision to step down from his current role as CEO and as a member of the board of directors by December 31, 2024. The board has initiated a formal search for a new CEO, retaining an executive recruiting firm to advance this effort. Thomas Hogan, Cellebrite’s executive chairman, will serve as interim CEO upon Carmil’s departure and until the search is complete and a new CEO joins Cellebrite. “Cellebrite is indebted to Yossi Carmil.
